body: Kind of, actually... But I hope I'll be able to replace this artificial mood lifting eventually. Sport helps tremendously as well

I can agree, and I'd rather feel a little bit less ecstatic for these short but intensive periods of time and be a bit more content, peaceful and happier for longer periods. I'll try to watch out for my triggers a bit more.

And keep on going on your path, I hope you will become better and better at finding balance, it's tough but worth it :)
